sources.scientific_reference: User-supplied Chen et al. (2002) and Gross et al. (2013) articles.
sources.status: AP-free constituent engineering baseline; not calibrated to Chen Figure 4 and not independently validated for a particular cured HTPB formulation.
sources.density_cp_conductivity: Retain the original input.lm.ap_htpb pure-constituent reference values provisionally; these are not the Figure-4-reconstructed thermal properties.
sources.kinetics: Chen Figures 5 and 6 pure-component Arrhenius endpoints. The generator converts physical speed prefactors to the phase-field normalization for each case.
sources.heat_release: Gross section 4.2: pure HTPB -300 cal/g and pure AP -100 cal/g. One cal/g = 4184 J/kg. Applied only during phase change; chemistry is frozen.
sources.mixing: Supply unblended constituent values. The homogeneous phase-change model applies the requested mass/volume mixing rules once.
sources.temperature: Cold temperature 300 K retained from the original sweep.
